convergence.note: Cumulative-window rule per organizer FAQ 2.9: converged when best(primary over last N scored iterations) - best(primary over everything before that window) <= epsilon. Crashed/debug iterations do not advance or reset the window. min_scored_iterations is a team-declared floor, permitted by the same FAQ, fixed here before the run. Raised from 12 to 25 for the continuation phase after run 1 converged at the earliest allowed point using only 5% of budget and 20% of wall-clock -- disclosed as a considered re-declaration for this phase, not a silent change.

search.note: Best-of-N: generate this many candidate responses per draft/improve call, validate all through compile->guard->dedup->smoke, quick-check survivors at seed 0, and only spend the full multi-seed confirmation on whichever scores best.

tree.note: retry_pool holds recent successful-but-not-promoted nodes with their own bucketed comparison against whatever beat them, so a good idea with a fixable flaw gets revisited with real diagnostic context instead of being discarded after one attempt.
